lines.text: Many Pokémon live only in forests and caves.\c\nYou need to be persistent and look everywhere\nto get different species.

Have you noticed the [VAR COLOR(0006)]skinny trees[VAR COLOR(0000)] on
the roadside?\c
They can be chopped down with the Secret
Technique called Chop Down, I hear.

The higher a Pokémon’s [VAR COLOR(0006)]CP[VAR COLOR(0000)] is, the higher its
Combat Power is!\c
I hear CP is a value made up of various stats
and things combined.
